svg.title: Poster study: a tornado tears across farmland
svg.desc: Graphic poster illustration: under a green-tinged sky and a dark storm cloud lit by lightning, a huge grey tornado funnel throws dirt and debris over a golden wheat field toward a red barn and silo; in the foreground a parent holds open a storm cellar door and shouts as the other parent and a child run toward it. Fictional scenario for a style study.
